turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until twenty to five, Hale, so let's not waste it. My son saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Don't manage me, Hale. Upset isn't the issue; procedure is. Was Owen heard before that zero went in, yes or no?
But I'm not changing the grade.

Then you'll defend it upstairs, because your own procedure, 4.2, says I'm called before any mark goes in, and nobody called me. I'm writing down that you won't change it. What exactly is that zero resting on, Hale?
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.

"Keep going if you like." I'm not here to fill your silence, Hale; either you put something in front of me that I can read, or I walk down the hall to the principal's office in about fifteen minutes. Your choice.
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.

Then here's how this goes: I'm going to the principal's office the minute I leave this room, and if that doesn't fix it, the board under section 42. You entered a zero before calling home and you still haven't told me what it rests on. Last chance, Hale: is there a document, or is it just your say-so?
